title: Larger patch sizes degrade local prediction performance
description: Scaling to larger Vision Transformers with larger input patches (ViT-G/16) can be detrimental for local prediction tasks such as object counting and depth prediction, as larger patches lose fine-grained spatial information.
canonical_description: larger patch sizes degrade performance on local prediction tasks

evidence.quote: the ViT-G/16 uses larger input patches, which can be detrimental for the local prediction tasks
